# vyos.blueprints.backup

Back up VyOS configurations in bulk

- Saves each router's configuration on the controller as `<backup_root>/<host>/<host>_<timestamp>.<ext>`, with one timestamp per run so the backups of one run belong together.
- `set` - `show configuration commands` via vyos.vyos.vyos_config `backup`, for reading and diffing.
- `cfg` - `show configuration` (hierarchical); this is the format vyos.vyos.vyos_config `replace=config` loads, so it is the one to restore from.
- A `.json` manifest records the VyOS version, model, serial number and time - used by upgrades to check versions.
- Retention keeps the newest `backup_keep` backups per router.
- Backups contain secrets (password hashes, keys). Files are written with mode 0600; protect `backup_root` accordingly.
- Bulk runs use the play's forks; use `throttle` or `serial` in the play to limit concurrency.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.backup
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backup_root` | str |  | `'{{ playbook_dir }}/backups'` | Backup directory on the controller. |
| `backup_formats` | list |  | `[set, cfg]` | Formats to save. |
| `backup_manifest` | bool |  | `true` | Write a facts manifest next to each backup. |
| `backup_keep` | int |  | `10` | Backups to keep per router; `0` keeps all. |
| `backup_dry_run` | bool |  | `false` | Only report which old backups retention would remove. |
| `backup_git_commit` | bool |  | `false` | Commit `backup_root` to git after the run (it must already be a git repository). |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify` in the same play after `main`. Checks this run's files exist and are not empty.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backup_formats` | list |  | `[set, cfg]` | Same value as for `main`. |
